User.title: User
User.description: User profile record storing account details and preferences.

email.description: The email address associated with the user account.

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

photoURL.description: URL to the user's avatar image.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user document was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user document was last updated.

Scan.title: Scan
Scan.description: Persisted scan result containing exposed listings and breach findings for the user.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the scan was executed.

checked.description: Total number of data sources checked.

demo.description: Whether this scan was run with demo profile data.

profile.description: Profile search terms used for the scan.

findings.description: List of discovered data broker listings.

breaches.description: List of discovered credential breach exposures.

swarmReports.description: Reports and live web sources discovered by the AI Reconnaissance Agent Swarm.

RemovalRequest.title: RemovalRequest
RemovalRequest.description: Opt-out deletion request sent to a data broker or tracking provider.

findingId.description: Associated finding ID from the scan.

brokerName.description: Name of the target data broker.

contactEmail.description: Contact email used for the removal request.

subject.description: Subject line of the removal request email.

body.description: Full text of the legal removal request.

status.description: Current status of the removal request.

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the request was sent by the user.

removalUrl.description: Direct URL to broker's opt-out or suppression form.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile documents stored by user ID.

/users/{userId}/scans/{scanId}.description: User personal scan history and findings.
